About RAVIOLI HOUSE

Homemade Pasta & Ravioli

Welcome & Buon Appetito

Ravioli is a type of Pasta comprising a filling enveloped in thin pasta dough Traditionally,ravioli were made at home. The filling varies accordingly to the area where they are prepared. The traditional ravioli its fillings are made with Ricotta cheese and Spinach which you can taste at RAVIOLI HOUSE with all the traditional sauces, prepared and served by Paolo & Massimo
